change.title: Production MFA Sandbox Bypass Guard
change.defect: The IAM login flow contained a hard-coded sandbox MFA code and disclosed that code in authentication errors.
change.fix: Sandbox MFA is now permitted only in isolated non-production sqlite-test mode, the test code is configurable, authentication errors no longer disclose the code, and PostgreSQL/live-traffic runtimes fail closed with PRODUCTION_MFA_PROVIDER_REQUIRED.
